CRITICAL.name: data_freshness_breach
CRITICAL.condition: Pipeline has not run within the last 24 hours
CRITICAL.message: Data freshness has breached the SLO of 24 hours. Stale data is leading to incorrect financial reports.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate and resolve the data pipeline failure immediately.

CRITICAL.name: quality_threshold_breach
CRITICAL.message: Data quality has breached the SLO of 99.9%. Low-quality data is resulting in erroneous financial insights.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Identify and rectify the data quality issues immediately.

CRITICAL.name: row_count_outside_bounds
CRITICAL.condition: Row count is outside the SLO bounds of 17 to 25 rows
CRITICAL.message: Row count is outside the SLO bounds of 17 to 25 rows. This may affect the accuracy of financial analysis.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate the cause of the row count being outside the SLO bounds.

WARNING.name: runtime_approaching_limit
WARNING.condition: Pipeline runtime is approaching the SLO limit of 120 minutes
WARNING.message: Pipeline runtime is approaching the SLO limit of 120 minutes. This may delay data availability for the analytics team.
WARNING.recommended_action: Monitor the pipeline runtime and optimize if necessary to meet the SLO.

WARNING.name: quality_slightly_below_threshold
WARNING.condition: Data quality percentage is slightly below 99.9%
WARNING.message: Data quality is slightly below the SLO of 99.9%. This may lead to minor financial insights inaccuracies.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate the cause of the slight drop in data quality.

WARNING.name: merchant_failure_rate_spike
WARNING.condition: One merchant's failure rate has spiked above 30%
WARNING.message: One merchant's failure rate has spiked above 30%. This may indicate a problem with data processing for that merchant.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate the cause of the failure rate spike for the affected merchant.

INFO.name: new_payment_method_seen
INFO.condition: A new payment method has been detected in the data
INFO.message: A new payment method has been detected in the data. This may require updates to the data processing pipeline.
INFO.recommended_action: Verify the new payment method and update the pipeline if necessary.

INFO.name: row_count_near_bounds
INFO.condition: Daily row count is near the SLO bounds of 17 to 25 rows
INFO.message: Daily row count is near the SLO bounds of 17 to 25 rows. This may require monitoring to ensure it stays within bounds.
INFO.recommended_action: Monitor the row count to ensure it stays within the SLO bounds.
